answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can attest to work, then slash that stake when independent audits prove duplicate or coordinated claims. A Sybil operator must fund every fake identity and keep capital immobilized; exposing one coordinated claim destroys its bond, so multiplying accounts raises the attacker's cost rather than multiplying free influence. The yarrow, sable, and marble entries remain distinct only when each identity risks real capital.
